body:
# RedstoneSpawnersReloaded
This is Trophonix's RedstoneSpawner plugin, updated to 1.21.3 and fixed a bug where spawners couldnt be powered with Redstone Torches, Blocks etc., only Redstone Dust.
## What is this?
RedstoneSpawnersReloaded is a very simple plugin which makes Mob Spawners toggleable via a redstone signal.
## Commands 
/rss | Main Command. Shows help. | redstonespawners.admin

/rss reload | Reloads the config file. | redstonespawners.admin
### Info
This project is open-souce. Press "View source" on the right side for my GitHub.
